text.ms:
1. Matlamat atau fungsi badan sukan adalah—

(a) untuk menggalakkan dan membangunkan sukannya;

(b) untuk memastikan perlembagaan atau kaedah-kaedahnya dipatuhi

oleh semua anggotanya;

(c) untuk memastikan aktiviti sukannya dikendalikan dalam

persekitaran sukan yang selamat, dan berintegriti termasuk untuk

mematuhi kaedah-kaedah antidoping yang diiktiraf

di peringkat antarabangsa; dan

(d) untuk mengambil langkah remedi bagi perkara-perkara

yang melibatkan keselamatan diri dan persekitaran termasuk

gangguan seksual dan penderaan.

2. Aktivitinya dikendalikan tanpa ada diskriminasi tentang jantina, ras,

warna kulit, agama, asal usul, bahasa, kecenderungan politik atau apa-apa

pandangan lain yang dipegang oleh anggotanya.
3. Keanggotaan badan sukan direkodkan dan disimpan dengan teratur.

4. Akaun teraudit sepenuhnya serta laporan mengenai segala aktiviti, dan

penggunaan dan perbelanjaan semua wang bagi tahun kewangan yang

sebelumnya dibentangkan dan diluluskan dalam mesyuarat agung tahunannya

dan seterusnya dikemukakan kepada Pesuruhjaya berserta dengan apa-apa

laporan lain yang dikehendaki oleh Pesuruhjaya.".

Dibuat 6 Mac 2023

[KBS.S.DS.1-05-70 Jld. 13 (4); PN(PU2)587/Jld. 4]

YEOH TSEOW SUAN

Menteri Belia dan Sukan

SPORTS DEVELOPMENT ACT 1997

SPORTS DEVELOPMENT (AMENDMENT OF THIRD SCHEDULE) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 37 of the

Sports Development Act 1997 [Act 576], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Sports Development (Amendment of

Third Schedule) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 March 2023.

Amendment of Third Schedule

2. The Sports Development Act 1997 is amended by substituting for the

Third Schedule the following schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE

[Section 19]

 CONSTITUTION OR RULES OF OTHER SPORTS BODIES UNDER THIS ACT

The sports body shall provide in its constitution or rules the following matters:

1. Objects or functions of the sports body are—

(a) to promote and develop its sports;

(b) to ensure its constitution or rules are abided by all its members;

(c) to ensure its sports activities are conducted in safe sports

environment, and with integrity including to comply with

anti-doping rules which are internationally recognized; and

(d) to take remedial actions for matters involving personal and

environment safety including sexual harassment and abuse.

2. Its activities are conducted without discrimination as to sex, race, colour,

religion, social origin, language, political inclination or any other opinion held by

its members.

3. Membership of sports body is recorded and kept in order.

4. Its fully audited accounts with reports on all activities, and the use

and disbursement of all funds for its preceding financial year to be laid

and approved in its annual general meeting and subsequently to be submitted

to the Commissioner together with such other reports as the Commissioner

may require.".

Made 6 March 2023

[KBS.S.DS.1-05-70 Jld. 13 (4); PN(PU2)587/Jld. 4]

YEOH TSEOW SUAN

Minister of Youth and Sports
